Dy cadjin ta dy chooilley obbreyder er ny lhaih veih'n çheu-chiare gys y çheu-yesh. Foddee oo yn oardagh y chaghlaa lesh crommaghyn. Son sampleyr: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). cloudflare-api-key-desc: Lesh ochill CloudFlare API, ta jeshaght ta e raane ayns dty choontey CloudFlare geddyn recortys DNS trooid proxy as barrantys CloudFlare Origin. Ta jeshaghtyn elley geddyn barrantys Let's Encrypt. Ta'n ochill sauailt er y hirveishagh as cha bee ee soilshit reesht.

email-recovery-attempts: Yn earroo smoo dy phrowalyn reesht
email-recovery-busy: Ta cur ny obbyr elley er y rolley fuirraght roie. Aahrog as prow reesht dy gerrid.
email-recovery-cancel: Cur ass çhaghteraghtyn y rolley fuirraght
email-recovery-changed: Yn caghlaa s'jerree liorish yn obbreyder
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Cur ass ooilley ny çhaghteraghtyn ta fuirraght nish son y gheddyr shoh? Bee nyn stoo scrysst as cha nod eh ve er ny gheddyn er-ash. Bee çhaghteraghtyn noa ta crooit lurg yn aghin shoh freilt.
email-recovery-description: Un linney son dagh gheddyr. Shir liorish ID yn ymmydeyr. Cha nel stoo ny çhaghteraghtyn ny ny magheryn post-l yn gheddyr er nyn soilshaghey. Ta scuirr son tammylt freayll çhaghteraghtyn t'ayn hannah as çhaghteraghtyn ry heet; ta goaill toshiaght reesht prowal çhaghteraghtyn y rolley fuirraght y chur nish. Ta cur ass scryssey çhaghteraghtyn va currit ayns y rolley fuirraght derrey traa yn aghin. My ta cur roie, prow reesht dy gerrid. Cha nod oo çhaghteraght ta goll er cur hannah y gheddyn er-ash, as foddee cur nagh vel shickyr ve jeant reesht. Ta marranysyn beayn as çhaghteraghtyn ta er roshtyn kione-earroo ny prowalyn ry gheddyn foast son scrutaght. Ta prowal çhaghteraghtyn nagh row speeideil reesht cur toshiaght er cruinney noa dy phrowalyn as freayll yn scuirr son tammylt t'ayn hannah.
email-recovery-empty: Cha nel çhaghteraghtyn ayns y rolley fuirraght ny gedderyn lesh cur er scuirr son tammylt.
email-recovery-failed: Cha dod yn obbyr ve er ny hickyraghey. Aahrog yn rolley fuirraght as prow yn jantys cheddin reesht my shegin.
email-recovery-oldest: Yn chied chur ayns y rolley fuirraght
email-recovery-retry: Prow çhaghteraghtyn nagh row speeideil reesht
email-recovery-retrying: Çhaghteraghtyn ta goll er prowal reesht
email-recovery-saving: Goaill yn rolley fuirraght post-l rish y traa…
email-recovery-superseded: Ta jantys ny s'noa liorish yn obbreyder er chur yn aghin shoh ass yn ynnyd. Ta stayd roie yn rolley fuirraght er ny soilshaghey.
email-recovery-unavailable: Cha nod yn rolley fuirraght post-l ve lhaiht. Scrutee entreilys yn reireyder as vel yn shirveishagh ry gheddyn.

error-notAuthorized: Cha nel kied ayd y duillag shoh y akin.
error-user-notCreated: Cha nel yn ymmydeyr shoh er ny chroo
error-username-taken: Ta'n ennym ymmydeyr shoh goit hannah
export-card-details: Myn-phoyntyn kaart (dagh kaart myr ayns cur kaart magh)
export-card-field-people: Deiney (Croodeyr, Shellooder, Olteynyn, Deiney lesh obbyr)
filter-on-desc: T'ou screeu kaartyn er y voayrd shoh. Broogh ayns shoh dy reaghey yn screeu.
import-attachment-auth-hint: Ta’n eaghtyrt ginsh ennymyn e choyrtyn agh cha nel eh cur lesh ny coadanyn. Dy chur lhiat ad, cur seyrey yn chirveish as cur-stiagh: cha nel ad ymmydit agh son y chur stiagh shoh, cha nel ad currit agh dys y seyrey shen, as cha vel ad sauailt dy bragh. Faag follym dy chur stiagh gyn ny coadanyn.
import-attachment-auth-token: Cowrey API, ogher API ny fockle-arrey app
import-board-instruction-asana: Cur stiagh JSON cur magh obbraghyn Asana ({ "data": [...] } veih cur magh Asana ny GET /tasks). Ta obbraghyn er nyn reaghey ayns rheynnyn (memberships); ta obbraghyn cooilleenit goll gys Jeant.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Ayns Businessmap (Kanbanize roie), foshil Advanced Search, reih Configure results dy reih ny collooyn, laad neose y coadan Excel, eisht reih y coadan .xlsx shen. Ta ny collooyn lhaiht liorish ny enmyn Baarle oc (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): my ta chengey elley ec dty choontey, caghlaa linney y chione gys Baarle hoshiaght. Ta Column jannoo rolleeyn as Lane cassanyn; ta shellooderyn, tagyn, daah, laaghyn, cooishyn as kianglaghyn ayr freayll nyn ynnydyn, as ta Priority, Size, Type as collooyn elley jannoo magheryn cliaghtit.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Ayns ClickUp, cur magh ny gnyn myr CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, ny cur magh reayrt List ny Table lesh dy chooilley cholloo), eisht greimee y CSV. Ta staydyn jannoo rolleeyn, ta rolleeyn ClickUp jannoo cassanyn, as ta gnyn jannoo kaartyn lesh ny far-obbraghyn, feallee currit daue, tagyn, laaghyn, toshiaght as traa oc.
import-board-instruction-csv: Cur stiagh dty Luoghtyn Scarrit lesh Cromman (CSV) / Luoghtyn Scarrit lesh Tab (TSV).
import-board-instruction-deck: Cur stiagh JSON boayrd NextCloud Deck (boayrd lesh "stacks", as "cards" ec dagh stack). Hig stackyn dy ve rolleyghyn as kaartyn dy ve kaartyn.
import-board-instruction-excel: Reih duillag-recknee .xlsx ayns aght WeKan (ny columnyn cheddin as cur magh Excel: Ennym, Coontey, Stayd/Rolley, Olteynyn, Cowraghyn, datyn, magheryn reih't). Ta'n chied row ny kione.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Fosh y coadan .boardarchive as cur stiagh board.jsonl y voayrd, lesh ny gyn e linney lhieggan. Ta tro yn çhilley boayrd son possaney cheet dy ve rolleeyn, ta troyn reih elley cheet dy ve lipaidyn, ta blockyn teks as kishtaghyn cowraghey cheet dy ve coontey as rolley scrutaghey, as ta cooishyn freilt. Cha nel jallooyn as ceanglaghyn er nyn gur stiagh.
import-board-instruction-issues: Cur stiagh rolley JSON jeh cooishyn __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Hig cooishyn dy ve kaartyn ayns rolleyghyn Foshlit / Dooint.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Cur stiagh JSON cur magh Kanboard: nhee lesh "columns" (ny obbraghyn lesh column_name) as rolley "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Hig columnyn dy ve rolleyghyn as obbraghyn dy ve kaartyn.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Ayns Kanri, foshil Import & Export as reih Export individual board (ny Export all data), eisht greimee y coadan .json. Ta collooyn jannoo rolleeyn as ta kaartyn jannoo kaartyn, lesh y coontey, traa jerrinagh, tagyn as daaghyn oc; ta gnyn kaart jannoo rolley scrutaghey. Veih cur magh ooilley ny fysseree, ta'n chied voayrd currit stiagh.
import-board-instruction-leo: Jean greimmaghey strughtoor Leo (coadan .leo). Ta ny ayrnyn ec y cheim s'yrjey cheet dy ve rollaghyn, ta ny ayrnyn foosyn dy jeeragh cheet dy ve kaartyn, lesh teks yn ayrn myr coontey y kaart. Ta ny ayrnyn ec keimyn s'diuney cheet dy ve rollaghyn scrutaghey. Ta ny ayrnyn ta cowrit er nyn ymmyrkey stiagh myr jeant.
import-board-instruction-linear: Ayns Linear, cur magh ny cooishyn myr CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, ny cur magh reayrt), eisht greimee y CSV. Ta staydyn jannoo rolleeyn, ta skimmyn jannoo cassanyn, as ta cooishyn jannoo kaartyn lesh y fer currit da, lipaidyn, laaghyn, cooish ayr, toshiaght, tomys, tullagh as kiaddey.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Cur lhiastey obbraghyn markdown ayn (yn cliaghtey ta greienyn markdown-kanban myr Obsidian Kanban jannoo ymmyd jeh): kione-lhieyn "## Ennym y rolley", lesh reddyn "- [ ]"/"- [x]" fo. Ta kione-lhieyn cheet dy ve nyn rolleyn as reddyn cheet dy ve nyn gairtyn.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Ayns MeisterTask, crig er ennym y halloo, reih Export project as cur magh y CSV, eisht greimee eh. Ta rheynnyn jannoo rolleeyn as ta gnyn jannoo kaartyn, lesh ny noteyn, yn traa jerrinagh, y fer currit da as ny tagyn oc; ta gnyn jeant freayll y lhaa v'ad jeant. Ta CSV scruit son cur stiagh MeisterTask hene obbraghey myrgeddin.
import-board-instruction-monday: Ayns monday.com, foshil claare y voayrd, reih More actions as Export board to Excel (lesh updates as subitems my sailt), eisht reih y coadan .xlsx shen. Ta'n cholloo Status jannoo rolleeyn as ta bunneeyn jannoo cassanyn; ta sleih, laaghyn, linney-traa as tagyn freayll nyn ynnydyn, ta collooyn elley jannoo magheryn cliaghtit as ta updates jannoo cooishyn.
import-board-instruction-notion: Ayns Notion, foshil y stoyr-fysseree myr duillag slane, reih ••• as Export, reih Markdown & CSV, as reih y coadan .zip t'eh laadey neose, ny un CSV stoyr-fysseree ass, ny greimee y CSV shen. Ta colloo enmit Status jannoo ny rolleeyn (fegooish, ta'n chied cholloo ta jeeaghyn myr reih dy yannoo eh, as ta coontey cur stiagh gra quoi), ta linnaghyn jannoo kaartyn lesh ard-ennym, tagyn myr lipaidyn, sleih myr olteynyn, laaghyn, as teks y duillag myr coontey; ta collooyn elley jannoo magheryn cliaghtit. Cha nel kianglaghyn, jallooyn as coyrtyn currit stiagh.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Ayns Nullboard, foshil y boayrd, reih Export this board... veih'n chlaare, foshil y coadan .nbx ayns reagheyder teks as greimee ny t'ayn. Ta rolleeyn jannoo rolleeyn as ta noteyn jannoo kaartyn: ta'n chied linney jeh note ny ard-ennym y chaart as y chooid elley ny coontey echey. Ta note raw geddyn y lipaid raw. Ta coadan lesh shiartanse boayrdyn cur stiagh y chied voayrd echey.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Ayns Obsidian, foshil coadan y voayrd Kanban myr Markdown (ny foshil y coadan .md ayns reagheyder teks), eisht greimee eh ooilley. Ta raaidyn jannoo rolleeyn lesh ny earrooyn kaartyn oc, ta kaartyn freayll ny tagyn, laaghyn, toshiaght, magheryn as rolley scrutaghey oc, as ta'n Archive jannoo kaartyn ayns y tashtey.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Cur stiagh JSON çhaglym work-packages OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Hig staydyn dy ve rolleyghyn as pakidyn obbee dy ve kaartyn.
import-board-instruction-opml: Coip stiagh skeaylley OPML, myr ta Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq as coarys elley cur magh eh. Ta nheeghyn ard-cheim çheet dy ve rolley, ta nyn gloan çheet dy ve kaartyn lesh y note myr coontey, as ta nheeghyn s'diuney çheet dy ve rolley scrutee. Ta nheeghyn cooilleenit çheet stiagh myr jeant.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Coip stiagh coadan Org mode, myr ta Emacs, Orgzly ny Beorg screeu eh. Ta kione-screeuyn ard-cheim çheet dy ve rolley as ta kione-screeuyn y nah cheim çheet dy ve kaartyn. Ta TODO as DONE, tosheeaghtyn, cowraghyn, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE as CLOSED er nyn reayll, as ta kishteeyn check as kione-screeuyn s'diuney çheet dy ve rolley scrutee.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Ayns Pivotal Tracker, foshil duillag MORE y halloo as reih Export CSV (ny reih skeealyn as reih Bulk Actions, CSV), eisht greimee y CSV. Ta dy chooilley stayd skeeal jannoo rolley as ta skeealyn jannoo kaartyn, lesh y sorch as lipaidyn oc, shellooderyn, sireyder, laaghyn, cooishyn, gnyn as lhiettalyn; ta Estimate jannoo Story points as ta aa-yannooyn jannoo sprintyn.
import-board-instruction-plane: Ayns Plane, foshil Workspace Settings, reih Exports, cur magh ny tullaghyn myr JSON, CSV ny Excel as laad neose y coadan .zip, eisht reih y coadan shen, ny un choadan t'ayn, ny greimee y JSON ny CSV. Ta staydyn jannoo rolleeyn, ta tullaghyn jannoo cassanyn, as ta cooishyn jannoo kaartyn lesh y cowrey-enney, ayr, feallee currit daue, lipaidyn, laaghyn, kianglaghyn as cooishyn oc; ta toshiaght, tomys, kiaddey as modul jannoo magheryn cliaghtit. Cha nel coontaghyn ny coyrtyn ayns cur magh Plane, myr shen cha nel ad currit stiagh.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: Ayns Quire, foshil claare y halloo as reih Export CSV, eisht greimee y CSV. Ta staydyn jannoo rolleeyn as ta gnyn jannoo kaartyn, lesh ny far-obbraghyn oc myr kaartyn paitchey, feallee currit daue, tagyn myr lipaidyn, laaghyn toshee, jerrinagh as jeant, coontey as toshiaght myr magher cliaghtit. Cha nel cooishyn as coyrtyn ayns CSV Quire.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Ayns Redmine, foshil Issues y halloo, reih Also available in: CSV ec bun y rolley, reih ny collooyn (All columns, lesh Description) as cur magh, eisht greimee y CSV. Ta Redmine genmys ny collooyn ayns dty chengey, myr shen soie dty chengey gys Baarle ayns My account roish cur magh. Ta dy chooilley stayd jannoo rolley as ta cooishyn jannoo kaartyn, lesh y tracker myr lipaid, fer currit da, ughtar, laaghyn, gnyn ayr as cooishyn kianglt; ta toshiaght, rheynn, lhieggan kione, traa smooinit, % Done as magheryn cliaghtit jannoo magheryn cliaghtit.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Ayns Super Productivity, foshil Settings, eisht Sync & Backup, reih Export Data as greimee ny t'ayns y coadan .json sp-backup. Ta dy chooilley halloo jannoo cassan as ta gnyn jannoo kaartyn ayns To Do, In Progress, Backlog ny Done, lesh ny noteyn, tagyn, traa jerrinagh, traa ceaut as far-obbraghyn oc; ta gnyn ayns y tashtey jannoo kaartyn ayns y tashtey.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Ayns Taiga, foshil Admin > Project > Export as laad neose dump y halloo (fuasgile coadan .json.gz hoshiaght), eisht greimee y JSON echey. Ta staydyn user story jannoo rolleeyn, ta user stories jannoo kaartyn lesh ny gnyn oc myr far-obbraghyn, ta cassanyn oc hene ec epics as cooishyn, as ta sprintyn, tagyn, cooishyn as eiyrtyssyn cliaghtit cheet maroo. Cha nel coyrtyn currit stiagh.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Ayns Tasks.org, foshil Settings, Backups as reih Export tasks, eisht greimee ny t'ayns y coadan .json shen. Ta rolleeyn jannoo rolleeyn as ta gnyn jannoo kaartyn, lesh ny noteyn, tagyn, laaghyn, cooishyn as far-obbraghyn oc; ta gnyn jeant freayll y lhaa v'ad jeant, as ta toshiaght jannoo magher cliaghtit.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Cur stiagh toradh task export: straneys JSON, ny un obbyr er dagh linney. Ta obbraghyn creaghnit goll gys Done, ta project as priority cheet dy ve lipaidyn, ta annotations cheet dy ve cooishyn, as ta depends cheet dy ve croghaneyn er obbraghyn ta cur bac orroo.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Ayns Teamwork.com, lhieen clowan Excel cur stiagh gnyn (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) as sauail eh myr .xlsx, eisht reih y coadan shen. Ta rolleeyn gnyn jannoo rolleeyn as ta gnyn jannoo kaartyn; ta gnyn ta toshiaght lesh -, # ny > jannoo far-obbyr jeh'n ghnyn erskyn (--, ## ny >> un chemmyrk ny s'diunid). Ta feallee currit daue, laaghyn as tagyn freayll nyn ynnydyn; ta Priority, Estimated time as Complete jannoo magheryn cliaghtit.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Ayns TickTick, foshil Settings, Account, Backup & Import as jean coip-sauchys, eisht greimee y coadan CSV. Ta dy chooilley rolley TickTick jannoo cassan as ta ny collooyn echey jannoo rolleeyn; ta gnyn freayll ny tagyn, laaghyn, rolley scrutaghey, toshiaght as far-obbraghyn oc.
import-board-instruction-todoist: Ayns Todoist, fosyl menu y halee as reih Export as a template, eisht coip stiagh yn coadan CSV. Ta ayrnyn çheet dy ve rolley, obbraghyn dy ve kaartyn, fo-obbraghyn dy ve rolley scrutee, noteyn dy ve cooishyn, as @labels as tosheeaghtyn p1 gys p3 dy ve cowraghyn.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Jean pastal coadan todo.txt: un obbyr er dagh linney, myr ta'n claare todo.txt as claaryn coardailagh screeu eh. Ta obbraghyn jeant ("x") goll dys Jeant, ta +project as @context çheet dy ve lipaidyn, ta (A) çheet dy ve lipaid tosheeaght, as ta due: as t: çheet dy ve dateyn jerrey as toshiaght.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Ayns Vikunja, foshil Settings, reih Data Export as laad neose y coadan .zip t'eh cur dhyt, eisht reih y coadan shen, ny greimee y data.json t'ayn. Ta buckets Kanban jannoo rolleeyn as ta gnyn jannoo kaartyn, lesh ny lipaidyn, feallee currit daue, laaghyn, coontey, rolleeyn gnyn myr rolleeyn scrutaghey as cooishyn oc; ta toshiaght, cronney jeant as jeant jannoo magheryn cliaghtit. Cha nel coyrtyn currit stiagh.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Ayns Wrike, cur magh tullagh ny filleeyr gys Excel, ny lhieen clowan cur stiagh Excel Wrike, eisht reih y coadan .xlsx shen. Ta linnaghyn filleeyr as tullagh jannoo cassanyn, ta Status jannoo rolleeyn as ta gnyn jannoo kaartyn, lesh Key, gnyn ayr, feallee currit daue, laaghyn toshee as jerrinagh, croghaneyn as coontey oc; ta Priority, Duration as collooyn elley jannoo magheryn cliaghtit.
